title: SeenPost
description: Deduplication index entry for raw X posts seen by any watch desk

id.description: Deduplication hash (SHA-256 of post_id or normalized content)

post_id.description: Original X post snowflake ID or URL

desk.description: Watch desk that first ingested this post

seen_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when post was ingested

raw_text_snippet.description: Optional snippet of raw text for audit review
